\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিকেল} (bikel)}{বিকেল (bikel)}]{\bn{বিকেল} (bikel) — the late afternoon}

\label{lesson:BN-C90-bikel}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a story, then the Bengali for a toy.

Say \textquotedblleft{}I speak Bengali\textquotedblright{} and \textquotedblleft{}I work.\textquotedblright{} (\emph{Āmi bānglā bôli}; \emph{āmi kāj kôri}.)
